docs-scene3d-ci.description: Documentation route with a Scene3D teaching surface under CI software rasterization. The network limit covers 1610.82 KiB measured in CI run 36273313254 with GPU timing, HDR post color, Sky, and the WebGPU to WebGL fallback. Load and blocking time remain separate gates; shader compilation on software renderers can create long tasks.

water-ci.description: Water route under CI software rasterization. The network limit covers 1846.28 KiB measured in PR #747 CI run 39971086334 after shared renderer-owned instance preparation. This replaces the 1845.26 KiB measurement in PR #727; the shared Scene3D chunk grows while both backend chunks shrink. The limit is the measurement rounded up to the next KiB. Load and blocking time remain separate experience gates. Long-task count is intentionally ungated because continuous software-raster frames straddle the 50ms boundary; real-GPU cadence is certified separately. PR #744 CI run 40027059297 measured 1,892,703 bytes (1848.34 KiB) with no renderer recovery. Of the five loaded framework scripts, only the startup Scene3D script changes from main: +1,757 raw bytes for camera command synchronization, ordered orbit targets and zoom height-floor enforcement. Set the network limit to 1849 KiB, rounding this observed transfer total upward under the existing policy; load and blocking-time limits are unchanged. PR #755 hierarchical spin: hosted exact-source CI run 40186690653 at dbbd76f767ae measured 1,894,176 bytes (1849.78 KiB) without renderer recovery. Parent/loader hooks and native retained transforms add framework delivery bytes; the hierarchy chunk remains demand-loaded. Set only network_kb to 1850 KiB under the existing round-up policy. LCP, TBT, renderer work counts, and production WASM ceilings are unchanged. PR #756 exact-source hosted CI run 40227381059 at 41284b41a465 measured 1,898,180 bytes (1853.69 KiB), without renderer recovery; diagnostic artifact 12612032298 is checksum-verified. Among the five loaded framework scripts, only the Scene3D startup body changes from this PR base (+363 raw bytes); the optional binary command chunk is not loaded by this route. The previous 1850 KiB target predates #742. Set only network_kb to 1854 KiB under the existing measured-total round-up policy. LCP, TBT, renderer and size allowance policies remain unchanged.
